title: McCain Counters Obama 'Arab' Question
summary: An AP clip from October 2008 of John McCain correcting a town hall questioner who called Barack Obama an Arab, telling her Obama is a decent family man. It is a brief campaign trail moment.
why: HN cites it as an example of dignified political discourse and of a Republican defending an opponent.

quote.text: He took the mic from her and said no mam, he's a good man.
